intro: Find mapped car charging stations across {countries}. Choose your connector, check the power and see who can use it.
tileError: The map is recharging. The station list still works.
footerText: Mapped car charging across {countries}. A clearer next stop, a little more road.
how2Text: Choose a connector and minimum mapped power. Missing specifications stay unknown.
how3Text: Check access and payment details, then open driving directions to the mapped station.
dataLicense: Location data: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Map tiles: OpenStreetMap. Icons: Lucide (ISC).
DATA_NOT_READY: The charging dataset is not ready yet. Please try again later.
comfort: A good connection, a little closer.
openNowHint: Based on mapped access hours. This does not show free connectors or working equipment. Unknown hours are excluded.
sourceHours: Community map details can be incomplete or outdated. Access hours, socket counts and power are mapped specifications, not live availability.
noLiveData: Mapped locations. No live occupancy or fault status.
stationTarget: Directions lead to the mapped station location; check vehicle access locally.
